newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei to boost number of 24-hour food stores-paper.
newsitem.headline: Daiei to boost number of 24-hour food stores-paper.

text.p: Japan's largest chainstore operator Daiei Inc plans to turn 100 of its food chain stores into 24-hour outlets, a Japanese business daily said.

Daiei, which opened its first 24-hour store in Kobe, western Japan, in 1995, will convert between 30 and 50 of its food outlets into 24-hour shops by the end of March 1998, increasing the number to 100 by the end of March 1999, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday.
In Japan, sales at small stores are suffering due to an increase in the number of large stores, as competition intensifies among chainstore operators, the paper said.
Daiei was not immediately available for comment on the report.
